concept: Seeing how different parts work together to make a whole thing work (like parts of a bicycle)
source_inspiration: original content, informed by da Vinci's cross-disciplinary observation tradition — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character takes apart or examines something (like a toy or machine) and discovers how its parts work together
exercise.reflection_prompt: What happened when one part was missing or broken?
exercise.practice: Student picks something with multiple parts and names two parts that work together

assessment.success_marker: student names two real parts and how they relate, not just a list of parts
